event: 2025 ILCA U 21 Europeans and Open European Trophy
procedural_matters: Case 7 was heard together with Case 6 and Case 5 in accordance with RRS 63.(2)(b) since all cases arose from the same incident.
ITA 222798 was represented by Sofia Visnovic.
EST 227283 was represented by Romi Safin.
BEL 221112 was represented by Danae Kapnisis.
Race Committee was represented by Yiannis Papazoglou.
facts: Sailing Instruction 6.2 states: Flag D displayed with one sound means “The warning signal will be made not less than 60 minutes after flag D is displayed” no boat shall leave her allocated place until this signal is made.
Sea state: 5–10 knots of wind with choppy waves.
The Delta flag was displayed on shore at 09:30, together with the Tango (towing allowed) and Blue flag (class flag ILCA 6 Woman).
ITA 222798, EST 227283 and BEL 221112 launched into the water at 09:35.
The last ILCA 6 Woman left the boat ramp at 09:55.
ITA 222798, EST 227283 and BEL 221112 were aware of the minimum 60-minute time difference between the Delta flag and the Warning signal, as stated in SI 6.2.
The race area was approximately 2.6 nautical miles from the boat ramp and upwind of the marina.
The coach boat of ITA 222798, EST 227283 and BEL 221112 experienced a problem and was unable to tow them to the race area.
ITA 222798, EST 227283 and BEL 221112 sailed on their own, without any coach towing them.
Race Committee informed the coaches of the intention to raise the orange flag at 10:40, and announced this on VHF. No one objected.
The orange flag was displayed at 10:40.
The warning signal for ILCA 6 Woman was diplayed at 10:45 (75 minutes after displaying flag D ashore).
ITA 222798, EST 227283 and BEL 221112 arrived to the race area 12 minutes after the starting signal of Race 4 for ILCA 6 Women.
conclusions: There was neither an improper action or improper omission of the Race Committee. Therefor the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
